summary: Verified both bugs from v109 are FIXED. BUG A (Block flow): the new confirmation Modal (block-confirm-sheet + block-confirm-yes) works end-to-end on web — Cancel path closes without API call, BLOCCA path fires POST /api/users/user_16f709708760/block, banner 'Hai bloccato questo utente' appears, menu switches to 'Sblocca utente', unblock fires DELETE and banner disappears. BUG B (Badge kicker color): on the yellow BUON SENSO card the 'SPILLA · TOCCA PER LE ALTRE' text now computes to rgb(0,0,0) (onBrandSecondary) — fully legible on the yellow background rgb(255,199,0). BASTIAN CONTRARIO branch (white on red) is preserved via the inline conditional at [id].tsx:540 — could not find a live bastian_contrario user to visually verify but code path is symmetric and correct. Regression: previous block API endpoints continue to behave correctly.
action_items: No action needed for these two bugs — both fixes verified via mobile-viewport Playwright E2E against the public URL.
Optional nice-to-have: consider also verifying the BASTIAN CONTRARIO branch when a suitable test fixture becomes available (all live users currently qualify for buon_senso).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean: badgeKicker/badgeTitle/badgeSubtitle no longer hardcode color in StyleSheet; inline conditional at [id].tsx:540/546/554 correctly toggles between onBrandPrimary and onBrandSecondary per badgeType.

Block confirmation Modal (Alert.alert replacement) is well-implemented: backdrop press is guarded by blockWorking, both testIDs present, error path still uses Alert.alert (fine — only fires after successful backend call fails).
seed_data_creation: None. Reset block state via curl DELETE before test to guarantee clean start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: chat_a token stored at /app/chat_a_token.txt. On web, inject via localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(token)). Test user_13f93cbd1ea9 (carlofarina) is a reliable BUON_SENSO fixture; user_16f709708760 (chatUserB) currently has only 6/10 votes so its badge is locked.
rca_of_issue: BUG A root cause was Alert.alert being silently a no-op on web + racy with menu Modal dismissal on Android. Fix replaces it with an in-app Modal — verified working. BUG B root cause was badgeKicker style hardcoding color:onBrandPrimary (white) making yellow-card text illegible. Fix removes the hardcoded color from StyleSheet and applies it inline conditionally on badgeType — verified computed color is rgb(0,0,0) on yellow card.
